g.text: BFW STEAM HEATER VER 1 - OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
BFW STEAM HEATER E-101 - FLASH-STEAM BFW HEATING
1. Flows in 1000 kg/h; temperatures in °C; pressures in kPa g. Design point of the simulator model.
2. Stream 8: vent V-104, trap bypass V-103 and shell drain V-105, all closed at design (no flags).
3. XV-100 is the SIS steam shut-off (FSLL-101, TSHH-108, PSHH-100, ESD).
